source_importers: acquire.py and import_sources.py; separate pinned Parquet/7z reader environment
rights_policy: User-approved exploratory use with provisional authorship and unresolved source-rights records. Preserve source-specific limitations and attribution; this approval does not establish underlying rights or verified human authorship. Do not publish raw text or transcripts.

sources.provenance: Document IDs are hashes of source URLs; recover original URLs where possible and cluster syndicated duplicates
sources.split_policy: Preserve training; partition original validation into new validation and final holdout before generation; exclude original test
sources.rights_status: Publisher article rights require review; dataset Apache metadata is insufficient

sources.provenance: Post, thread, owner, revision, and duplicate-link IDs; verify snapshot content dates before selection
sources.split_policy: No official task splits; keep connected threads, duplicate links, and qualified known author IDs together
sources.rights_status: CC BY-SA version depends on contribution date; preserve attribution and assess derivative obligations

sources.provenance: Reviewer IDs, product IDs, dates; assign record IDs from source file hash and position; check merged-product duplicates
sources.split_policy: No official task splits; group known reviewers and duplicate review/product identities before assignment
sources.rights_status: Dataset page does not supply a clear redistribution license; requires review
sources.integrity_status: Record local SHA-256 after a separately approved acquisition; upstream hashes not yet established

sources.provenance: Common Crawl UUID, URL, capture timestamp, dump and WARC path; verify every selected capture date
sources.split_policy: Unsplit corpus; group canonical URLs, duplicate pages and identified author/thread clusters before assignment
sources.rights_status: ODC-BY and Common Crawl terms apply; underlying webpage rights require review
sources.selection_status: Per-domain filtered yields are unverified; stop on shortfall rather than silently replacing quotas

excluded_candidates.amazon_reviews_multi: Defunct and restrictive; do not substitute mirrors
excluded_candidates.wikitext: Only 60 official validation articles and limited author/revision provenance; not needed for this first proposed mix
excluded_candidates.cornell_cmv: Official heldout and conversion differences need a separate protocol; not needed for this first proposed mix
